# openmetadata_llm_model (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata LLM model inside an LLM service. LLM models record the base model, provider and version served through the parent service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_llm_service" "openai" {
  name         = "openai"
  service_type = "OpenAI"
  display_name = "OpenAI"
  description  = "LLM service for the OpenAI API."
}

resource "openmetadata_llm_model" "chat" {
  name           = "gpt-4o"
  service        = openmetadata_llm_service.openai.fully_qualified_name
  base_model     = "gpt-4o"
  model_provider = "openai"
  display_name   = "GPT-4o"
  description    = "General-purpose chat model used by the support assistant."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_model` (String) Base model the deployment serves, for example gpt-4o.
- `name` (String) LLM model name. Changing it replaces the model, because the name is part of its fully qualified name.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent LLM service. Changing it replaces the model.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the LLM model.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.
- `model_provider` (String) Provider of the base model, for example openai. The server fills it in when omitted.
- `model_version` (String) Version of the base model. The server fills it in when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name, in the form service.name.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_llm_model.chat 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, in the form service.name.
terraform import openmetadata_llm_model.chat openai.gpt-4o
```
